segments.description: Sermon on divine healing and health as an expression of divine perfection.
segments.speaker: Minister
segments.title: Divine Healing and Health: The Expression of Divine Perfection
segments.summary: The sermon powerfully establishes that divine healing and health are not optional benefits but fundamental expressions of God's perfection available to every believer. Through scriptural foundations in Colossians 2:9-10 and Romans 8:1-2, 11, the message demonstrates that believers are complete in Christ and empowered by the same Spirit that raised Jesus from the dead. The preacher emphasizes that sickness is spiritual bondage incompatible with God's nature, and that through faith, believers should walk in divine health daily rather than merely seeking healing when sick. Personal testimony and biblical examples, including the dry bones of Ezekiel 37 and Jesus' healing ministry, illustrate that God's power transcends physical limitations when believers understand their identity in Christ and operate in faith, making divine health a present reality rather than a future hope.
